evidence: Read task/instruction.md cold. It is 17 lines of first-person/team prose with no headings, numbered acceptance list, shall/must table or feature matrix. Line 1 frames it as a person's ask: 'Can you build HireOps, the workspace our recruiting team lives in all day? ... so the hard part is that nobody's work gets trampled when someone else acts.' Lines 3-9 describe needs as lived workflow ('I often move several candidates together; that has to be all of them or none, and I need to be able to undo my last move'; 'If a message arrives while I am reading further up, leave my place alone and just tell me there is something new'; candidates 'must never see our internal notes, why someone was rejected, or anyone else'). Line 11 delegates exact rules to /instructions/hireops_rules.md and says 'layout and names are yours'. The only recipe-like content is line 13-15 (Node.js/Express/SQLite, node /app/server.js, port 3000/PORT, GET /api/health, /app/app.db/DB_PATH, seed path, no package installs), which is the template-mandated runtime contract that check 4 requires to be stated and which the template integration.md (lines 3-14) also carries; it is written as prose and explicitly leaves structure open ('How you lay the other files and routes out under /app is your call'). It names one endpoint (health), not an endpoint list, and prescribes no file layout. Line 17 account list is the required credentials, also expected by the delivery profile. Against skill quality-checks.md:11 defect list (numbered acceptance lists, shall/must spec table, feature matrix, build recipe of framework+file layout+endpoint list): none present in instruction.md. Observation (not a defect for this row): hireops_rules.md is a structured rules note with tables, bullets and HTTP codes (401/403/404/409) and says 'Follow them exactly'; that is an /instructions note the brief points to, not the prompt, and it still disclaims routes/field names/ids/labels (lines 3-5). Spec density there belongs to checks 2/6, not row 1. Adversarial tries: (a) a broken app cannot pass by virtue of this row - it grades prose only, no runtime evidence needed; (b) a conforming alternative is not forced into a hidden recipe: layout, names, routes and file structure are explicitly left to the builder, and drag is optional. No runtime measurement is required for this row, so no missing-evidence risk.
